mapper.select: SELECT id,user_id,run_id,plan_version_id,idempotency_key,request_hash,status,attempts, result::text AS result_json,error_code,error_message FROM agent.plan_commit WHERE idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey} FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.snapshot::text AS snapshot_json, p.status AS plan_status, r.status AS run_status, r.latest_plan_version_id, r.expires_at <= clock_timestamp() AS expired FROM agent.plan_version p JOIN agent.workflow_run r ON r.id=p.run_id AND r.user_id=p.user_id JOIN agent.conversation c ON c.id=r.conversation_id AND c.user_id=r.user_id WHERE p.id=#{planVersionId} AND p.run_id=#{runId} AND p.user_id=#{userId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status='ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE OF r,p
mapper.update: WITH stamp AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT clock_timestamp() AS at) UPDATE agent.plan_commit SET status='RUNNING',attempts=attempts+1, started_at=GREATEST(stamp.at,created_at,updated_at),finished_at=NULL, error_code=NULL,error_message=NULL, updated_at=GREATEST(stamp.at,created_at,updated_at),version=version+1 FROM stamp WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('PENDING','FAILED') AND attempts<#{maxAttempts}

WITH stamp AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT clock_timestamp() AS at) UPDATE agent.plan_commit SET status='SUCCEEDED', finished_at=GREATEST(stamp.at,created_at,updated_at,started_at), result=#{resultJson}::jsonb,error_code=NULL,error_message=NULL, updated_at=GREATEST(stamp.at,created_at,updated_at,started_at),version=version+1 FROM stamp WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING'

WITH stamp AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT clock_timestamp() AS at) UPDATE agent.plan_commit SET status='FAILED', started_at=GREATEST(stamp.at,created_at,updated_at), finished_at=GREATEST(stamp.at,created_at,updated_at),attempts=attempts+1, error_code=#{errorCode},error_message=#{errorMessage}, updated_at=GREATEST(stamp.at,created_at,updated_at),version=version+1 FROM stamp WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('PENDING','FAILED') AND attempts<10
